answer: A remote attestation quotes the enclave code before the identity is allowed to act, and the chain groups identities by quoted measurement, so a farm running one image in one fleet collapses into a single counted voter. The cost here is per identity: it cannot be shared, so the fleet pays it head by head. The garden is the quoted measurement, the jetty the group it forms, and the hollow the voice that group is worth; the garden and the jetty collapse a farm, while only a fresh hollow of hardware escapes the grouping.
